document-title.help: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation
document-title.galleryWhy: gallery/build.ts writes index.html with no <title>; the app sets one in app/layout.tsx metadata

heading-order.help: Heading levels should only increase by one
heading-order.galleryWhy: the gallery's <Page> h1 is followed straight by WeekGrid's mover h3; in the app CalendarViews puts the week's h2 between them

page-has-heading-one.help: Page should contain a level-one heading
page-has-heading-one.galleryWhy: the view is a fragment with no gallery <Page>; in the app it sits under PlanPathScreen's h1 (or, for the mini-app frame, has no route yet)
